reason: v4.73.1 is the fresh-Windows first-run fix pass found by Windows Sandbox testing: migration statements are comment-stripped before execution so non-UTF8 databases (WIN1252 embedded clusters) no longer hard-fail the drizzle chain on non-ASCII comment characters; setup.mjs treats a failed auto-migrate as fatal instead of warn-and-continue (no more bootable partial schemas); /setup gains an instance nav + entry CTAs so the post-install landing page is no longer a dead end. Platform-only: the SDKs are not republished. @dashclaw/cli 0.7.4 ships separately (pg_ctl server lifecycle for elevated Windows shells, UTF-8 initdb, VC++ runtime auto-install).
